'''2012 World Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed World Championship, 12–14 October 2012, in Bochum, Germany, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="awards">https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/</ref><ref name="decklists">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2012-decklists/</ref><ref name="tdl">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/</ref> [[Emil Wallin]] defeated [[Angelo Consoli]] in the final (by 1 card). Published lists on the Players Committee desk are the Day 2 PDF only: the 2012-decklists page names Day 2 and Day 3, but only Day 2 is hyperlinked; the tournament-decklists archive likewise lists Worlds Day 2 for 2012. No Day 1 or Team Tournament PDF was published.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' Bochum, Germany
* '''Dates:''' 12–14 October 2012
* '''Winner:''' [[Emil Wallin]]

Day 2 Xerox and typed sheets are in [[:File:2012 Worlds Day 2.pdf]] (110 pages; 87 content sheets, 23 blank). Every content sheet in that PDF is transcribed in the table. Blank sheets are omitted. Alex Cetrino's sheets say the lists are the same as yesterday and do not name them. Day 1, Day 3, and the Team tournament were not published.

== Day 3 ==

Day 3 lists were not published as a downloadable PDF (index text only). Standings: [[Emil Wallin]] def. [[Angelo Consoli]].
